This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This was a known bug fixed in version 3.2.1 by pull request #901, which added ordering by id for reports created at the same moment to prevent overlap between pages. Your instance was on 3.2.0 and lacked this fix. Since you upgraded to 3.2.1 and confirmed the issue is resolved, no further change is needed.
